comparison_basis: Frozen R5-1B/R5-1C evidence and inspected deterministic code only; no intervention was executed.

frozen_evidence_supporting: Five of six VALIDATION speakers exceeded the historical correct-only FAR reference.
The same fixed threshold had materially different false-addition behavior across splits.
frozen_evidence_against_or_limiting: R5-1C also found substantial positive/negative overlap.
Runtime speaker adaptation may require support audio or assumptions not present in a single-word request.
A_calibration_only.runtime_assumptions: Would require a globally frozen TRAIN-only transform or an explicitly designed calibration context; per-speaker oracle information is unavailable.
A_calibration_only.contamination_risk: high if current VALIDATION informs the transform; manageable only under TRAIN-only preregistration
A_calibration_only.smallest_valid_experiment: A separately preregistered TRAIN-speaker LOSO audit of one fixed calibration mechanism, with no VALIDATION formula selection.

frozen_evidence_supporting: Substitution-only, deletion-only, and substitution-plus-deletion negatives all contributed frozen false positives.
R4 already provides deterministic KEEP/SUB/DELETE hypothesis construction in the same CTC model space.
R5-1 compared INSERT only with KEEP, leaving explicit alternative relations unmodeled.
frozen_evidence_against_or_limiting: Correct-only words were the largest frozen false-positive cohort.
One-edit competition cannot fully explain mixed or multiple errors.
It only partially targets speaker-dependent relative-score shift.
B_relation_competition.runtime_assumptions: Expected text, word audio, one frozen CTC posterior, and deterministic sequence constructors are sufficient.
B_relation_competition.contamination_risk: low for a TRAIN-only preregistered experiment; high only if formulas are ranked on consumed VALIDATION
B_relation_competition.smallest_valid_experiment: Freeze one coherent BEST_INSERT-versus-BEST_NON_ADDITION definition and run one TRAIN-only 12-fold speaker-LOSO comparison with unchanged acoustic logits.

frozen_evidence_supporting: The frozen audit found both calibration shift and class overlap.
frozen_evidence_against_or_limiting: A combined first experiment would confound which mechanism caused any change.
It adds more design choices and overfitting risk after VALIDATION consumption.
Runtime calibration assumptions are not yet frozen.
C_combined_relation_and_calibration.runtime_assumptions: Requires every relation-competition input plus an independently justified calibration context.
C_combined_relation_and_calibration.contamination_risk: highest of the three because multiple design degrees of freedom could be informed by consumed evidence
C_combined_relation_and_calibration.smallest_valid_experiment: Only after isolated mechanisms are preregistered; a factorial TRAIN-only design would be needed to separate their effects.

preference_reason: It is the smallest runtime-compatible change with a direct mechanistic link to frozen substitution/deletion false-positive cohorts, reuses one coherent likelihood space, and permits a clean TRAIN-only causal comparison. It does not claim to solve speaker shift or correct-only overlap.
